Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Aditya - 8 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
4. Riya - 9 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
5. Sharda - 63 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Nikhil stands by the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Nikhil: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil gets into the car.]

Anjali: "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil gets on the bus.]

Nikhil (softly): "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Sharda: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Sharda (laughing): "That's great!"

[Nikhil sips hot tea from a cup.]

Anjali: "I really enjoyed today."
